description:
Project Name: Lawn Maintenance and Gutter Cleaning

Solicitation No. 1240BF26Q0024

Project Location:

Powers Ranger Station

42861 Highway 242

Powers, Oregon 97466

This synopsis publicizes a forthcoming solicitation for Lawn Maintenance and Gutter Cleaning at the Powers Ranger Station. As authorized by FAR 12.201-1 Simplified procedures (c)(2) the contracting officer has chosen to solicit quotations directly from Contractors who live in Oregon.

If the physical address of your company is in Oregon and you believe you would be a good fit for this project, please email the following to lorenzo.montya@usda.gov  

  1. Company Name
  2. UEI SAM number
  3. Point of Contact Name
  4. Phone number
  5. Email address

The estimated solicitation issue date is March 19, 2026

Quotations will be due April 6, 2025.  

Quoters must be registered in www.sam.gov by the solicitation due date of April 6, 2026.

The solicitation will be set-aside for small businesses, based on NAICS Code 561730 (Landscaping Services).        

The solicitation will not be posted to SAM. The solicitation will be emailed directly to a limited number of Contractors who live in Oregon.
